name: Jump Rope
description: TSA rules for jump ropes on planes.

carryOn.reason: Jump ropes and skipping ropes are allowed in carry-on baggage. TSA does not classify them as weapons.

checkedBag.reason: Jump ropes are allowed in checked baggage.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring a jump rope on a plane?

travelTips: Jump ropes are a great travel workout tool — lightweight and carry-on friendly

faq.question: Can I bring a jump rope on a plane?
faq.answer: Yes, jump ropes are fully allowed in carry-on and checked baggage.

faq.question: Will TSA allow a jump rope in carry-on?
faq.answer: Yes, TSA permits jump ropes in carry-on bags. They are not classified as weapons.
